market_briefing.lede: For a Rox GTM / revenue-engineering seat: buyers are funding AI in the business (not just IT), agents are entering real workflows, and the bar is shifting to governed execution — skills, runtime controls, and measurable outcomes.

bullets.text: GTM stack: shareable “skills” / playbooks on coding agents + data planes (e.g. Clay Skills Marketplace) — distribution layer next to AI SDR/CRM narratives.
Revenue AI buyers: line-of-business AI budgets rising (BCG ~3.3% of revenue, mostly outside IT) while autonomy outruns controls — expect security/HITL asks in deals.
